comments.body: I have a question for those who have been accepted to MSc in CS. Did you receive any form or email to specify your major preference (Machine Intelligence, Data Management Systems etc). If not, when should we select our major. Another question is that, I have mentioned the major I wanted to pursue in my statement of purpose but I decided to change it. Can I change it ? If so, is it something bad ?
comments.author: Longjumping-Club-321
